last.q: For more than 77 years, ADP has helped small businesses and entrepreneurs navigate complex regulatory environments and achieve their dreams with confidence,
last.a: said Maria Black, president and CEO, ADP

last.q: ADP is off to a strong start in fiscal 2027 with first quarter results that reflect the resilience of our business model and the trust our clients continue to place in us,
last.a: said Maria Black, President and Chief Executive Officer, ADP

last.q: ADP’s strong fiscal 2026 performance is grounded in the long-term value that matters most to our clients: trust,
last.a: said Maria Black, President and Chief Executive Officer, ADP

last.q: We delivered a strong quarter, and it reflects what ADP does best – executing with precision for our clients while continuing to invest in defining the future of HCM,
last.a: said Maria Black, President and Chief Executive Officer, ADP

last.q: ADP's strong second quarter results reflect the breadth of our innovative products, differentiated service, and exceptional experiences that we deliver for clients every day,
last.a: said Maria Black, President and Chief Executive Officer, ADP

last.q: Fiscal 2026 started off with solid financial performance and meaningful progress across our strategic priorities,
last.a: said Maria Black, President and Chief Executive Officer, ADP
